identity.name: Memori
identity.one_liner: Open-source memory engine for LLM apps and agents that need persistent context injection.
identity.short_description: Memori is an open-source memory engine from GibsonAI for giving LLM applications and agents persistent memory, context injection, and configurable recall behavior.

positioning.why_it_matters: Memori matters because many agent products need a practical memory engine before they need a full agent framework. It gives teams a focused way to add durable context to conversations and workflows.

seo_article.intro: Memori is an open-source memory engine from GibsonAI for giving LLM applications and agents persistent memory, context injection, and configurable recall behavior.
seo_article.what_it_is: Memori is an open memory-system resource to evaluate by what it stores, how recall works, how memory is scoped, and whether users or teams can inspect, correct, export, or delete durable context.
seo_article.why_it_matters: Memori matters because many agent products need a practical memory engine before they need a full agent framework. It gives teams a focused way to add durable context to conversations and workflows.
seo_article.how_it_works: Test Memori with repeated sessions. Add facts, update them, ask for recall, inspect retrieval behavior, and verify deletion or scoping controls before storing sensitive user or project memory.

faq.question: What should I check before using Memori?
faq.answer: Test Memori with repeated sessions. Add facts, update them, ask for recall, inspect retrieval behavior, and verify deletion or scoping controls before storing sensitive user or project memory.

faq.question: Is Memori open source?
faq.answer: Memori is listed with Apache-2.0 based on the official source links in this profile. Re-check the repository, model card, or docs before production use.

faq.question: Who should evaluate Memori?
faq.answer: Memori is most worth evaluating for developers adding memory to LLM applications.
